**Description**
 Do you want to build AI\-powered tooling that keeps custom silicon running reliably at scale? In Annapurna Labs at Amazon Web Services (AWS), we sit at the intersection of software and hardware, designing the systems that detect failures, generate repair instructions, and automate qualification for Trainium products. As a Software Development Engineer III, you will lead the technical design and delivery of this tooling platform — combining generative AI techniques with deep hardware knowledge to solve problems that few teams in the industry encounter. With hardware complexity and scope expanding rapidly, this is a rare opportunity to shape how we bring the next generation of custom chips to operational stability.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and deliver generative AI\-based tools that identify complex hardware failures, dynamically create repair instructions from hardware system designs, and automate the qualification framework for post\-new\-product\-introduction hardware changes on Trainium systems.
* Own system design decisions across the tooling software stack, evaluating tradeoffs in scalability, maintainability, and performance while partnering with silicon design and operations teams on cross\-functional technical discussions.
* Collaborate with hardware design and sustaining teams to align tooling updates with upcoming silicon changes, creating the right integration checkpoints to ensure successful delivery.
* Drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team through code reviews, design reviews, and mentorship — raising the quality bar and helping fellow engineers grow.
* Evaluate and refine generative AI model outputs used in the tooling platform, applying responsible AI practices to ensure accuracy and reliability at production scale.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You start your morning reviewing system health metrics for the tooling platform, then join a design review where a teammate walks through a new generative AI model for automated failure diagnosis on Trainium hardware. You ask probing questions that sharpen the approach. After lunch, you pair with an engineer to work through a tricky data\-modeling problem, then shift to a cross\-team sync with hardware design engineers to align on upcoming silicon changes that will require updates to your qualification automation. Later, you write a technical document outlining how the tooling will scale to support the next generation of Trainium products.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team within Annapurna Labs builds the AI\-powered software tooling that ensures Trainium systems meet operational stability targets before handoff to sustaining teams. We work at the intersection of software and silicon alongside systems development engineers, software development engineers, and hardware engineers — a cross\-functional mix that is rare even within AWS. As Annapurna Labs continues to expand its custom chip portfolio, we are investing in new generative AI capabilities and scaling our platform to keep pace. If you are excited about solving problems where software meets hardware at industry\-leading scale, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for talented software engineers who have a passion for Big Data and distributed systems at trillions of transactions scale to help build the next generation of AWS internal services. Our applications are responsible for processing billions of events per second and terabytes of data per hour. As a foundational system we scale with the growth of cloud computing at Amazon. The AWS Billing team is responsible for Metering Usage and Generating Monthly Charges. These include but are not limited to enabling: AWS product pricing, AWS product subscriptions, AWS product discount programs, customer credit management, storing AWS product usage, computing the bill, the estimated bill, computing tax, and storing bills and line items for external customer consumption.
   

  

 As a Software Developer, you have the opportunity to lead the paradigm shift in streaming Big Data by building applications on top of AWS technologies such as EC2, S3, Kinesis, EMR, DynamoDB, Redshift, Aurora, and many more. Additionally, you can build meaningful software that can radically change how AWS wins our largest customers over to the Cloud. And finally, as an Amazon engineer, you get to own the full lifecycle of your systems, work on challenging problems at "Amazon Scale", and collaborate with some of the best in the business.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one\-on\-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
   

  

 Learn more about Amazon on our Day 1 Blog: https://blog.aboutamazon.com/
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Collaborate with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
* Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
* Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
* Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault\-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
* Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
* Work in an agile environment to deliver high\-quality software.

**Description**
 About US
   

  

 Amazon Interactive Video Service (Amazon IVS) is AWS's fully managed live streaming service, built on the same battle\-tested technology that powers Twitch and trusted by thousands of enterprises across gaming, social, live commerce, sports, and entertainment.
   

  

 Our mission: enable developers to build communities around live video. We handle everything from ingest to processing to delivery at global scale, so developers can focus on creating interactive, engaging live experiences for their audiences. Whether you're streaming to tens of millions of concurrent viewers or just getting started, Amazon IVS removes the complexity so developers can move fast.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Software Development Engineer on the Amazon IVS Control Plane team, you will build customer\-facing experiences and highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems that power Amazon IVS.
   

  

 The IVS Console is the primary interface through which customers configure, monitor, and manage their IVS resources, while the IVS Control Plane provides the APIs and backend systems that orchestrate those resources at AWS scale. You will work across both to build seamless end\-to\-end experiences for IVS customers. Your work will directly empower developers, broadcasters, and businesses around the world to deliver low\-latency, interactive video experiences.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop intuitive user interfaces for the IVS Console using modern web technologies
* Design and develop scalable backend services and public APIs for Amazon IVS
* Build distributed systems that manage the configuration, orchestration, and lifecycle of live video streaming resources using TypeScript, Go or similar modern programming languages
* Define and maintain infrastructure using infrastructure as code practices, primarily with AWS CDK
* Work closely with engineers, product managers, UX designers, and applied scientists to deliver seamless customer experiences
* Ensure systems are highly available, scalable, and secure at AWS scale
* Apply engineering best practices across testing, performance optimization, observability, and code quality
* Collaborate with other AWS teams to integrate shared services and deliver consistent customer experiences across AWS services
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, design reviews, and on\-call rotations
* Drive operational excellence through automation, metrics, alarms, and runbooks


 A day in the life
   

  

 You might start the morning by checking how the service is running and investigating an issue that surfaced overnight. Later, you could join a design discussion for a new customer feature, thinking through the experience from the public API, console, all the way to the backend systems that make it work. After lunch, you might work through an interesting technical problem with a teammate, review a change, or meet with product to refine how a feature should work for customers. Some days are focused on building intuitive customer experiences, while others take you deep into distributed systems and large scale service operations. You’ll have the opportunity to follow problems across the stack and see the features you build through from idea to launch.
